page.layout: One page of text, one column, no marginal notes. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Verse epitaph set in italic below the text. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: ualde exaltare, Lutherumque & alios Christianæ ueritatis professores opprimere studuit. In astrolo-gia ac diuinatione, illa præcipuè quæ malorum de-monum adiutorio fit, primas obtinens, multa mirá-cula iuuenis fecit: & sororem suam, Iuliam Farne-siam, Alexandro sexto pontifici ad usum uenereū pro rubro gilero dedit. In ipso Papatu uero, nouü religionis genus senex adinuenit, ad diuini cultum augmentum ut cuidam matronæ nobili gratificaretur, globulum quendam ligneum Papali benedictio-ne consecrauit, & ut contra molestationes varias collo appensum ferret, paternis consiliis admonuit.

Mysterium magnum est. Romanæ synagogæ, sanctissimæ matris, res compositurus, concilium uniuersale Mantuan indixerat, sed frustra: nec posteriore Tridentino quicquam effecit. Supra cæteris eius actis sanctissimis Appendices quære. Anno Domini 1549. è uiuis excessit, decimo die Nouembris: uacabatque sedes illa mensibus tribus, ac diebus totidem.
main_text.head: Epitaphium huius Pauli:

p.i: Puluis eram terra, tenuisque in puluere uentus, Fœmineo fuetus[?] uiuere lacte senex.
Attamen italicis non doctior artibus alter, Quiq; Deum uberius ludere posset, erat.
Nemq; uno summi fatuati numine Reges, Cæperunt ipsi bella mouere Deo.

page.notes: No marginal text is printed; small marks in the left margin beside "fiam" and "pro rubro" are not readable text. The page is faded and the paper is stained at the edges. Doubtful readings: "fuetus" in the epitaph (the letter after "fu" is unclear); "Cæperunt" (the first vowel is unclear, possibly a plain a); "uenereū" and "nouü" (the macron or umlaut marks are uncertain). Printing error left as printed: "Mantuan" (for Mantuam, as printed). Hyphenation at "astrolo-gia", "mirá-cula", "de-monum", "Farne-siam" and "benedictio-ne" follows printed line breaks; the hyphen after "gratificare" is not visible, so the word is written whole.
